data.title: Swimming prohibited in water bodies
data.text: District Magistrate, North Goa District has prohibited swimming, bathing, or entering waterfalls, abandoned quarries, rivers, lakes, ponds and other similar natural water bodies in North Goa District. This order has come into force from August 24, 2025 and shall remain in operation for a period of 30 days. DI/INF/AXP/SAG/CR/SN/2025/648
data.source: Goa Department of Information and Publicity

data.title: Closure of dudhsagar waterfalls circuit for wildlife proliferation
data.text: Office of the Deputy Conservator of Forests Wildlife and Ecotourism (North) Division Panaji has informed that Dudhsagar Waterfalls tourism circuit located in Bhagwan Mahaveer National Park, Mollem will be closed for vehicle movement w.e.f. June 01, 2024, for the proliferation of wildlife and due to advancement of monsoon in the State of Goa.
data.source: Goa Department of Information and Publicity

data.title: Advisory to prevent drowning incident
data.text: Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, South Goa District have issued advisory to General Public and tourists to refrain from entering/taking bath/swimming in water bodies, lakes, rivers, waterfalls, mining pits etc. during the ongoing monsoon season in view of several drowning incidents reported in the South Goa District during this monsoon. The General public are requested to adhere to this advisory, so that drowning incident can be prevented and precious lives are saved.
